mapper.select: SELECT id, provider_id, model_name, adapter_name, upstream_model_name, base_url, enabled, load_balance_enabled, rate_limit_enabled, rpm, tpm FROM models WHERE model_name = #{modelName}

SELECT pa.id AS account_id, ak.id AS key_id, ak.api_key FROM model_accounts ma JOIN provider_accounts pa ON pa.id = ma.provider_account_id JOIN account_keys ak ON ak.provider_account_id = pa.id WHERE ma.model_id = #{modelId} AND ma.enabled = 1 AND pa.enabled = 1 AND pa.provider_id = #{providerId} AND ak.enabled = 1 ORDER BY pa.id ASC, ak.id ASC
